module_summary: AXI-Stream FIFO: input words packed into a dual-pointer circular RAM with commit pointer for frame mode, read through a RAM pipeline register chain to the output stream, with depth/frame status outputs.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Circular RAM storing packed tdata/tlast/tuser words written at wr_ptr, read at rd_ptr.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem; increments on each accepted input word.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem; increments when data moves into the output pipeline.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; frames become visible to reader only after commit; used for empty.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag from pointer compare; deasserts s_axis_tready and gates drop/mark logic.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag from commit vs read pointer; gates read pointer increment and output valid.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: In-frame overflow flag: write pointer a full FIFO ahead of commit pointer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; with tready triggers write into mem.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, derived from full and drop/mark configuration.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload packed into s_axis word written to mem.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker stored with data and steering frame commit/drop logic.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input user sideband stored in mem, checked for bad-frame marker.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid driven from last pipeline valid stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output ready from sink; advances the read pipeline.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload unpacked from last pipeline register.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying words from mem toward the output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid bits per RAM pipeline stage; bubbles allow stage advance.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Pipeline advance enable: shifts stages and reads new word from mem.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Dropping-frame flag in frame/mark modes; suppresses writes until tlast.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Mark-bad-frame flag forcing tlast and bad tuser into stored word.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame mode flag forcing commit of oversize frame being sent through.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame; used to decide marking.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy output from depth_reg (wr minus rd pointer).

anchors.name: depth_reg
anchors.why: Registered occupancy computed as wr_ptr_reg minus rd_ptr_reg.

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed occupancy output from depth_commit_reg.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped frame, from overflow_reg.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped bad frame, from bad_frame_reg.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a committed good frame, from good_frame_reg.

groups.name: FIFO memory
groups.description: Circular RAM holding packed AXIS words.

groups.name: Write control
groups.description: Write/commit pointers, full detection, frame drop/mark/commit logic.

groups.name: Read pipeline
groups.description: Read pointer, empty detection and RAM output pipeline to m_axis.

groups.name: Status
groups.description: Depth counters and frame overflow/bad/good status pulses.

groups.name: AXIS input
groups.description: Slave stream fields packed into a FIFO word.

groups.name: AXIS output
groups.description: Master stream fields unpacked from pipeline output.
